name: PB&J

ingredients.name: peanut butter, plus more if desired

instructions.primary_message: Evely spread the peanut butter on both slices of bread. Evely spread the jam or jelly on one of the peanut-buttered slices.
If desired, sprinkly jam/jelly with salt, then close sandwich and serve or pack for lunch.

schema_metadata.keywords: peanut butter and jelly, peanut butter and jelly sandwich

description: The perfect PB&J has an ideal ratio of peanut butter to jelly, a particular bread thickness, and a deliberate construction. Here's the explanation.
notes:
Optional substitutions: jelly → jam

Notes: Toast the bread, if desired. Regular toast using a toaster oven works well if eating the sandwich right way, but in our tests, we found that it grew overly firm and stale as the day progressed, so it's less ideal for a packed lunch. Alternatively, you can lightly griddle the bread in butter or neutral oil, though again please note that bread griddled in butter is not as delicious once the bread has cooled and the butter had congealed, so not ideal for a packed lunch.
author: Daniel Gritzer
